title: School board tradeoffs
prompt: A school board has to weigh classroom aides, after-school counseling, and a public budget dashboard under one constrained operating plan. What should move first?

contributions.body: Classroom aides should come first because they relieve immediate staff load in the places students feel it first.
contributions.evidenceText: The shortest path to better classroom conditions is additional adult support.

contributions.body: Counseling should not disappear from the digest because the highest-need students often show up later in a chronological thread.
contributions.evidenceText: Mental health needs are easy to underweight when the thread is crowded.

contributions.body: The public dashboard matters because legitimacy drops when the board makes tradeoffs without a visible record.
contributions.evidenceText: Transparency is a live governance need, not only a reporting add-on.

responses.body: I would still route that in, even if it is not the top spending choice, because transparency changes whether people accept the tradeoff.
